author: Dr Ben Miles
description:
A 13-year-old Swiss Brown cow named Veronika has demonstrated flexible multipurpose tool use by selecting the appropriate end of a deck brush to scratch different parts of her body. This groundbreaking discovery challenges long-held assumptions about cattle intelligence and has important implications for animal cognition research and farming ethics.

Source Article: https://www.sciencefocus.com/news/cow-tool-use
